role.zh: 阶跃星辰 StepFun 创始人兼 CEO

why.en: Former chief scientist of Microsoft Research Asia's internet engineering institute. The Step series has the clearest multimodal understanding-and-generation line among Chinese labs and is the main supplier to on-device intelligence.
why.zh: 前微软亚洲互联网工程院首席科学家。Step 系列在多模态理解与生成上路线最鲜明，是终端智能领域的主要供给方。

title.en: The Step series: multimodal understanding and generation for terminal intelligence
title.zh: Step 系列：面向终端智能的多模态理解与生成

title.en: StepAudio 3 Realtime Technical Report
title.zh: StepAudio 3 Realtime Technical Report

note.en: StepFun released the StepAudio 3 Realtime technical report, an audio-language model built for fluid, low-latency spoken interaction.
note.zh: StepFun发布了StepAudio 3 Realtime技术报告，这是一款面向流畅、低延迟语音交互的音频语言模型。

title.en: StepAudio 3 Gen Technical Report
title.zh: StepAudio 3 Gen Technical Report

note.en: StepFun released the StepAudio 3 Gen technical report, a general-purpose audio generation model supporting zero-shot voice cloning, voice design, sound effects and music.
note.zh: StepFun发布了StepAudio 3 Gen技术报告，这是一款通用音频生成模型，支持零样本音色克隆、音色设计、音效与音乐生成。

title.en: $Φ$-Bench: Can Large Language Models Engineer the Infrastructure That Powers Them?
title.zh: $Φ$-Bench: Can Large Language Models Engineer the Infrastructure That Powers Them?

note.en: Jiang Daxin co-authored Φ-Bench, a benchmark testing whether large language models can engineer the infrastructure that powers them.
note.zh: 姜大昕参与撰写了Φ-Bench论文，该基准测试评估大语言模型能否设计支撑自身运行的基础设施。

title.en: Scheduling Mixed RL Rollouts Beyond Prefix Locality
title.zh: Scheduling Mixed RL Rollouts Beyond Prefix Locality

note.en: StepFun infrastructure work on scheduling reinforcement-learning rollouts that mix domains and feedback types, where prefix-aware routing alone stops paying off.
note.zh: 阶跃星辰的基础设施研究，针对混合领域与多种反馈形式的强化学习 rollout 调度，指出仅靠前缀感知路由已不够用并给出新方案。

title.en: TSLoc: Self-Supervised Faulty Node Localization Framework in Large-scale Training Clusters
title.zh: TSLoc: Self-Supervised Faulty Node Localization Framework in Large-scale Training Clusters

note.en: StepFun paper introducing TSLoc, a self-supervised framework for localizing faulty nodes in large-scale AI training clusters.
note.zh: StepFun团队论文提出TSLoc，一种在大规模AI训练集群中自监督定位故障节点的框架。

title.en: SpotAgent: Grounding Visual Geo-localization in Large Vision-Language Models through Agentic Reasoning
title.zh: SpotAgent: Grounding Visual Geo-localization in Large Vision-Language Models through Agentic Reasoning

note.en: StepFun paper on SpotAgent, grounding visual geo-localization in vision-language models through agentic reasoning.
note.zh: StepFun团队论文提出SpotAgent，通过智能体式推理将视觉地理定位落地到视觉-语言模型中。

title.en: TensorCast: The Missing Tensor Management Layer in Large Language Model Infrastructure
title.zh: TensorCast: The Missing Tensor Management Layer in Large Language Model Infrastructure

note.en: Proposes a dedicated tensor management layer for LLM infrastructure, treating tensors as persistent state shared across distributed components rather than per-job data.
note.zh: 提出在大模型基础设施中增加一层专门的张量管理，把张量视为分布式组件间共享的持久状态，而非单次计算的数据。

title.en: ParaASR: Multi-Token Prediction for Fast and Long-Context LLM-Based Speech Recognition
title.zh: ParaASR: Multi-Token Prediction for Fast and Long-Context LLM-Based Speech Recognition

note.en: Speeds up LLM-based speech recognition with multi-token prediction for long-context audio, continuing StepFun's Step-Audio line of work.
note.zh: 用多 token 预测加速基于大模型的长上下文语音识别，延续阶跃星辰 Step-Audio 系列的工作。

title.en: GAUGE: Grading Agent-Built Financial Models Without a Golden Answer
title.zh: GAUGE: Grading Agent-Built Financial Models Without a Golden Answer

note.en: A grading framework for agent-built financial models in cases where no golden answer exists, from StepFun's finance line with FinStep and SJTU.
note.zh: 面向没有标准答案的场景，提出对智能体所建财务模型的评分框架，出自阶跃星辰与 FinStep、上海交大合作的金融方向。

title.en: Don't Predict, Prioritize: Rethinking GPU Reliability Assessment
title.zh: Don't Predict, Prioritize: Rethinking GPU Reliability Assessment

note.en: Argues GPU reliability should be handled by prioritising which nodes to inspect rather than predicting failures, drawn from operating large training clusters.
note.zh: 提出 GPU 可靠性应从「预测故障」转向「排序哪些节点该先查」，经验来自大规模训练集群的运维。

title.en: MentalThink: Shaping Thoughts in Mental SVG World
title.zh: MentalThink: Shaping Thoughts in Mental SVG World

note.en: Gives multimodal LLMs an executable "mental visualisation" mechanism by having them think with SVG, a visual-symbolic reasoning paradigm.
note.zh: 让多模态大模型用 SVG 进行「心智可视化」推理，提出一种可执行的视觉—符号推理范式。

title.en: PerceptionRubrics: Calibrating Multimodal Evaluation to Human Perception
title.zh: PerceptionRubrics: Calibrating Multimodal Evaluation to Human Perception

note.en: A rubric-based multimodal evaluation framework aimed at the gap between saturated benchmark scores and real-world brittleness.
note.zh: 基于评分细则的多模态评测框架，针对基准分数已饱和但真实场景仍脆弱的落差问题。

title.en: Skill-Guided Continuation Distillation for GUI Agents
title.zh: Skill-Guided Continuation Distillation for GUI Agents

note.en: Tackles the off-trajectory drift that behaviour cloning leaves in GUI agents by distilling skill-guided continuations from expert data.
note.zh: 针对行为克隆训练的 GUI 智能体偏离专家轨迹的问题，提出技能引导的续写蒸馏方法。

title.en: JetSpec: Breaking the Scaling Ceiling of Speculative Decoding with Parallel Tree Drafting
title.zh: JetSpec: Breaking the Scaling Ceiling of Speculative Decoding with Parallel Tree Drafting

note.en: Pushes past the scaling ceiling of speculative decoding with parallel tree drafting, so a larger draft budget keeps paying off.
note.zh: 用并行树状草稿突破投机解码的扩展上限，使增大草稿预算仍能继续带来加速。

title.en: From Knowing to Doing: A Memory-Controlled Benchmark for LLM Trading Agents on Stock Markets
title.zh: From Knowing to Doing: A Memory-Controlled Benchmark for LLM Trading Agents on Stock Markets

note.en: A memory-controlled benchmark for LLM trading agents, separating what a model knows from what it can actually act on in markets.
note.zh: 面向大模型交易智能体的记忆受控基准，把「模型知道什么」与「在市场中能否据此行动」区分开来评测。

title.en: AndroidDaily: A Verifiable Benchmark for Mobile GUI Agents on Real-World Closed-Source Applications
title.zh: AndroidDaily: A Verifiable Benchmark for Mobile GUI Agents on Real-World Closed-Source Applications

note.en: A verifiable benchmark that tests mobile GUI agents against real closed-source apps rather than simulators or open-source stand-ins.
note.zh: 可验证的移动端 GUI 智能体基准，直接在真实的闭源应用上测试，而非依赖模拟环境或开源替代品。

title.en: StepAudio 2.5 Technical Report
title.zh: StepAudio 2.5 Technical Report

note.en: Technical report for StepFun's Step-Audio 2.5 unified audio-language model, the company's main speech line.
note.zh: 阶跃星辰统一音频语言模型 Step-Audio 2.5 的技术报告，是公司语音方向的主线成果。

title.en: Step-Audio-R1.5 Technical Report
title.zh: Step-Audio-R1.5 Technical Report

note.en: Technical report for Step-Audio-R1.5, which carries chain-of-thought reasoning into acoustic and spoken tasks.
note.zh: Step-Audio-R1.5 的技术报告，把思维链推理引入声学与语音任务。

title.en: WebVR: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for WebPage Recreation from Videos via Human-Aligned Visual Rubrics
title.zh: WebVR: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for WebPage Recreation from Videos via Human-Aligned Visual Rubrics

note.en: Benchmarks multimodal LLMs on recreating web pages from video rather than text prompts or static screenshots, scored against human-aligned visual rubrics.
note.zh: 评测多模态大模型从视频（而非文本提示或静态截图）复现网页的能力，并用与人类判断对齐的视觉细则打分。

title.en: DM0: An Embodied-Native Vision-Language-Action Model towards Physical AI
title.zh: DM0: An Embodied-Native Vision-Language-Action Model towards Physical AI

note.en: DM0, an embodied-native vision-language-action model built for physical AI instead of adapted from internet-pretrained models.
note.zh: DM0：面向物理世界原生设计的视觉—语言—动作模型，而非把互联网预训练模型迁移到具身任务上。

title.en: PRIME: A Process-Outcome Alignment Benchmark for Verifiable Reasoning in Mathematics and Engineering
title.zh: PRIME: A Process-Outcome Alignment Benchmark for Verifiable Reasoning in Mathematics and Engineering

note.en: A benchmark checking whether reasoning verifiers judge the process and not just the final answer, across mathematics and engineering.
note.zh: 考察推理验证器是否真的在评判过程而不只是最终答案的基准，覆盖数学与工程题目。

title.en: Step 3.5 Flash: Open Frontier-Level Intelligence with 11B Active Parameters
title.zh: Step 3.5 Flash: Open Frontier-Level Intelligence with 11B Active Parameters

note.en: Step 3.5 Flash, StepFun's open sparse mixture-of-experts model with 11B active parameters, aimed at agentic use at low serving cost.
note.zh: Step 3.5 Flash：阶跃星辰开源的稀疏 MoE 模型，激活参数 11B，面向低成本部署的智能体场景。

title.en: GEBench: Benchmarking Image Generation Models as GUI Environments
title.zh: GEBench: Benchmarking Image Generation Models as GUI Environments

note.en: Benchmarks image generation models used as GUI environments, testing whether they can predict future interface states from instructions.
note.zh: 评测把图像生成模型当作 GUI 环境使用的效果，考察它们能否依据指令预测界面的后续状态。

title.en: R-Align: Enhancing Generative Reward Models through Rationale-Centric Meta-Judging
title.zh: R-Align: Enhancing Generative Reward Models through Rationale-Centric Meta-Judging

note.en: Improves generative reward models for RLHF by meta-judging the rationale behind a verdict rather than the verdict alone.
note.zh: 通过对判断背后的理由（而非只对结论）进行元评判，改进 RLHF 中的生成式奖励模型。

title.en: STEP3-VL-10B Technical Report
title.zh: STEP3-VL-10B Technical Report

note.en: Technical report for STEP3-VL-10B, StepFun's lightweight open multimodal foundation model.
note.zh: 阶跃星辰轻量级开源多模态基础模型 STEP3-VL-10B 的技术报告。

title.en: PaCoRe: Learning to Scale Test-Time Compute with Parallel Coordinated Reasoning
title.zh: PaCoRe: Learning to Scale Test-Time Compute with Parallel Coordinated Reasoning

note.en: Parallel Coordinated Reasoning, a training-and-inference framework for scaling test-time compute, co-authored with StepFun chairman Harry Shum.
note.zh: 提出并行协同推理框架，用于在训练与推理两端扩展测试时计算，合作者包括阶跃星辰董事长沈向洋。

title.en: Trade-R1: Bridging Verifiable Rewards to Stochastic Environments via Process-Level Reasoning Verification
title.zh: Trade-R1: Bridging Verifiable Rewards to Stochastic Environments via Process-Level Reasoning Verification

note.en: Extends verifiable-reward RL from maths and code into stochastic trading environments by verifying reasoning at the process level.
note.zh: 通过在过程层面验证推理，把可验证奖励的强化学习从数学与代码扩展到随机的交易环境。

title.en: Alpha-R1: Alpha Screening with LLM Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
title.zh: Alpha-R1: Alpha Screening with LLM Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning

note.en: Uses LLM reasoning trained with reinforcement learning to screen investment alphas that decay under regime shifts.
note.zh: 用强化学习训练的大模型推理来筛选在市场风格切换下容易失效的投资因子。

title.en: Step-DeepResearch Technical Report
title.zh: Step-DeepResearch Technical Report

note.en: Technical report for Step-DeepResearch, StepFun's autonomous research agent and its evaluation against open-ended real-world tasks.
note.zh: 阶跃星辰自主研究智能体 Step-DeepResearch 的技术报告，并针对开放式真实任务给出评测。

title.en: Dynamic Sparsity in Large-Scale Video DiT Training
title.zh: Dynamic Sparsity in Large-Scale Video DiT Training

note.en: StepFun paper studying dynamic sparsity techniques to speed up large-scale video diffusion transformer training.
note.zh: StepFun团队论文研究动态稀疏化技术，以加速大规模视频扩散Transformer的训练。

title.en: Thinking by Doing: Building Efficient World Model Reasoning in LLMs via Multi-turn Interaction
title.zh: Thinking by Doing: Building Efficient World Model Reasoning in LLMs via Multi-turn Interaction

note.en: StepFun paper proposing "Thinking by Doing," building efficient world-model reasoning in LLMs via multi-turn interaction.
note.zh: StepFun团队论文提出“边做边想”方法，通过多轮交互为大语言模型构建高效的世界模型推理能力。

title.en: ReasonEdit: Towards Reasoning-Enhanced Image Editing Models
title.zh: ReasonEdit: Towards Reasoning-Enhanced Image Editing Models

note.en: StepFun paper introducing ReasonEdit, a reasoning-enhanced approach to image editing models.
note.zh: StepFun团队论文提出ReasonEdit，一种增强推理能力的图像编辑模型方法。

title.en: Learning to Compress: Unlocking the Potential of Large Language Models for Text Representation
title.zh: Learning to Compress: Unlocking the Potential of Large Language Models for Text Representation

note.en: StepFun paper on compressing text into compact representations to extend what large language models can do with it.
note.zh: StepFun团队论文研究将文本压缩为紧凑表示，以拓展大语言模型对文本的处理能力。

title.en: Mind-Paced Speaking: A Dual-Brain Approach to Real-Time Reasoning in Spoken Language Models
title.zh: Mind-Paced Speaking: A Dual-Brain Approach to Real-Time Reasoning in Spoken Language Models

note.en: StepFun paper proposing a dual-brain architecture for real-time reasoning in spoken language models.
note.zh: StepFun团队论文提出“心智步速说话”双脑架构，用于语音语言模型的实时推理。

title.en: LAVa: Layer-wise KV Cache Eviction with Dynamic Budget Allocation
title.zh: LAVa: Layer-wise KV Cache Eviction with Dynamic Budget Allocation

note.en: StepFun paper on LAVa, a layer-wise KV cache eviction method with dynamic budget allocation for efficient LLM inference.
note.zh: StepFun团队论文提出LAVa，一种按层动态分配预算的KV缓存淘汰方法，以提升大模型推理效率。

title.en: InfiniteHBD: Building Datacenter-Scale High-Bandwidth Domain for LLM with Optical Circuit Switching Transceivers
title.zh: InfiniteHBD: Building Datacenter-Scale High-Bandwidth Domain for LLM with Optical Circuit Switching Transceivers

note.en: StepFun paper on InfiniteHBD, a datacenter-scale high-bandwidth domain design using optical circuit switching for LLM training.
note.zh: StepFun团队论文提出InfiniteHBD，利用光电路交换构建数据中心级高带宽域，用于大模型训练。

title.en: DistTrain: Addressing Model and Data Heterogeneity with Disaggregated Training for Multimodal Large Language Models
title.zh: DistTrain: Addressing Model and Data Heterogeneity with Disaggregated Training for Multimodal Large Language Models

note.en: StepFun paper on DistTrain, a disaggregated training system addressing model and data heterogeneity for multimodal LLMs.
note.zh: StepFun团队论文提出DistTrain，一种针对多模态大模型的解耦训练系统，用于应对模型与数据的异构性。

title.en: SE-Agent: Self-Evolution Trajectory Optimization in Multi-Step Reasoning with LLM-Based Agents
title.zh: SE-Agent: Self-Evolution Trajectory Optimization in Multi-Step Reasoning with LLM-Based Agents

note.en: StepFun paper on SE-Agent, using self-evolving trajectory optimization to improve multi-step reasoning in LLM-based agents.
note.zh: StepFun团队论文提出SE-Agent，通过自我演化的轨迹优化提升基于大模型的智能体的多步推理能力。

title.en: Step-Audio 2 Technical Report
title.zh: Step-Audio 2 Technical Report

note.en: Technical report for Step-Audio 2, StepFun's speech model, with Jiang listed among the senior authors.
note.zh: Step-Audio 2技术报告，姜大昕位列高级作者之中，介绍StepFun的语音模型。

title.en: $2.5B pre-IPO round at a $10B post-money valuation
title.zh: 25 亿美元 Pre-IPO 轮，投后估值 100 亿美元

body.en: Investors include Tencent, Qiming, 5Y Capital, Shanghai SSCI, China Life PE and Pudong Venture Capital. Share reform completed in late April, red-chip structure dismantled — standard preparation for a Hong Kong listing.
body.zh: 投资方包括腾讯、启明创投、五源资本、上海国资引领基金、国寿股权与浦东创投。4 月底完成股改并拆除红筹结构，为港股上市的标准准备动作。

title.en: Series B+ over RMB 5B; Yin Qi becomes chairman
title.zh: B+ 轮超 50 亿元；印奇出任董事长

body.en: A record single round for China's LLM sector at the time. Yin Qi joins as chairman, pairing StepFun's models with Qianli Technology's vehicles.
body.zh: 当时中国大模型赛道的最大单轮。印奇出任董事长，将阶跃的模型与千里科技的车绑定。

title.en: 从姜大昕到施凯文，印奇正在重搭一个“阶跃星辰”
title.zh: 从姜大昕到施凯文，印奇正在重搭一个“阶跃星辰”

body.en: StepFun co-founder Yin Qi is rebuilding the company's leadership, moving the top role from Jiang Daxin to Shi Kaiwen.
body.zh: 阶跃星辰联合创始人印奇正在重组公司领导层，由施凯文接替姜大昕的核心职位。

title.en: 从姜大昕到施凯文，印奇正在重搭一个“阶跃星辰”
title.zh: 从姜大昕到施凯文，印奇正在重搭一个“阶跃星辰”

body.en: Coverage reports Yin Qi is reshaping StepFun's leadership, transitioning the company from founding CEO Jiang Daxin to Shi Kaiwen.
body.zh: 报道称印奇正在调整阶跃星辰的领导层，公司正从创始人兼CEO姜大昕过渡到施凯文。

title.en: 阶跃星辰姜大昕：金融垂类大模型正从单点应用走向金融AI基础设施共建
title.zh: 阶跃星辰姜大昕：金融垂类大模型正从单点应用走向金融AI基础设施共建

body.en: StepFun founder Jiang Daxin said vertical financial LLMs are moving from point applications toward shared financial AI infrastructure, laying out his view of where the sector is headed.
body.zh: 阶跃星辰创始人姜大昕表示，金融垂类大模型正从单点应用走向金融AI基础设施共建，阐述了他对行业发展方向的判断。

title.en: 阶跃星辰姜大昕：金融垂类大模型正从单点应用走向金融AI基础设施共建
title.zh: 阶跃星辰姜大昕：金融垂类大模型正从单点应用走向金融AI基础设施共建

body.en: StepFun founder Jiang Daxin said vertical financial large models are moving from point applications toward jointly building financial AI infrastructure.
body.zh: 阶跃星辰创始人姜大昕表示，金融垂类大模型正从单点应用走向金融AI基础设施的共建。

news.source: 新浪财经_金融信息服务商

title.en: 从姜大昕到施凯文，印奇正在重搭一个“阶跃星辰”
title.zh: 从姜大昕到施凯文，印奇正在重搭一个“阶跃星辰”

body.en: A profile detailed StepFun's leadership restructuring, in which Yin Qi took the chairman role alongside Jiang Daxin as CEO, forming a new core decision-making team.
body.zh: 一篇报道详述了阶跃星辰的管理层重组：印奇出任董事长，与担任CEO的姜大昕等组成新的核心决策团队。

title.en: 阶跃星辰姜大昕：金融垂类大模型正从单点应用走向金融AI基础设施共建
title.zh: 阶跃星辰姜大昕：金融垂类大模型正从单点应用走向金融AI基础设施共建

body.en: StepFun CEO Jiang Daxin said vertical finance LLMs are shifting from point applications to shared financial AI infrastructure.
body.zh: 阶跃星辰CEO姜大昕表示，金融垂类大模型正从单点应用走向金融AI基础设施共建。

title.en: 改籍回国！AI六小龙之一阶跃星辰拆除开曼架构：冲刺港股IPO|姜大昕|月之暗面|智能体|估值|模型_手机新浪网
title.zh: 改籍回国！AI六小龙之一阶跃星辰拆除开曼架构：冲刺港股IPO|姜大昕|月之暗面|智能体|估值|模型_手机新浪网

body.en: StepFun dismantled its Cayman Islands holding structure and changed its corporate nationality back to China ahead of a planned Hong Kong IPO, under founder Jiang Daxin.
body.zh: 在创始人姜大昕带领下，阶跃星辰拆除了开曼群岛控股架构并将企业注册地迁回中国，为筹备港股IPO做准备。
